requirement.description: Missing ctx argument in testbench functions causing TypeError for simulator regression tests.
requirement.contract: Simulator testbench functions should accept a ctx parameter when called via add_testbench. The testbench functions in test_sim.py need to be updated to accept the ctx parameter for async functions.

requirement.description: Domain lookup failure in DomainLookupTestCase due to incorrect domain comparison.
requirement.contract: The lookup_domain method should correctly compare ClockDomain objects by identity rather than equality. Two ClockDomain objects with the same properties but different instances should not be considered equal.

requirement.description: Memory test failures due to incomplete implementation in RTLIL backend.
requirement.contract: The RTLIL backend memory conversion should properly handle async and sync read operations without causing assertion errors.
